wdqs_usage.client_throttle: batched 24 labels per query, 1.0s sleep between batches, single-threaded — well inside the service's concurrency limits
wdqs_usage.anonymous_rate_limit: shared per-IP budget; a throttled response would look like missing data, which is why the raw snapshot records the binding count

relocation_risk_reason: COVID-19 era. Fixtures in these seasons were played behind closed doors and, in some cases, at neutral or substitute grounds. football-data.co.uk carries no venue column, so a relocated match is undetectable per fixture and the season is excluded wholesale rather than assumed normal.
